entities.name: Eloise Wicker
entities.description: A human detective from Nephalia, Innistrad.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Region of Innistrad Eloise comes from.

entities.name: Jacob Hauken
entities.description: A geist-caller who worked with Eloise and has the special powers of the Vizag Atum.

entities.name: Lord Nellick
entities.description: The employer who hired Eloise and Hauken; actually the body Cyril Rav possessed.

entities.name: Cyril Rav
entities.description: A necro-alchemist who died in a geistbomb misfire and then possessed living people to gain power.

entities.name: Millicent
entities.description: Leader of the ghosts haunting Rav.

entities.name: Alrun River
entities.description: River near the township attacked by a roving geist.

entities.name: Travails
entities.description: An event before which Eloise and Hauken first worked together.

events.summary: Eloise and Hauken are hired by Lord Nellick to investigate a roving geist attacking people near the Alrun River.
events.quote: the two were hired by Lord Nellick to investigate a roving geist attacking people in a local township near the Alrun River

events.summary: Cyril Rav misfires a geistbomb, killing many people including himself; as a geist he possesses living bodies to gather influence.
events.quote: had misfired a geistbomb - an explosive device fueled with dead souls - that killed a bunch of people, including himself

events.summary: Rav, in the form of Nellick, discovers Hauken's powers and offers him a partnership, which Hauken accepts; the duo disappears leaving bodies behind.
events.quote: He offered Hauken an unusual partnership, which Hauken accepted.

events.summary: Annoyed by Hauken's betrayal, Eloise offers her services to Millicent to track the fugitives.
events.quote: Eloise offered her services to Millicent to track the fugitives

relations.note: Worked together before the Travails and on the Nellick case, until Hauken betrayed her.
relations.quote: Eloise and Hauken worked together before the Travails.
Rav, in the form of Nellick

relations.note: Leads the ghosts haunting Rav for revenge.
relations.quote: started haunting him under the lead of Millicent
